mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_summary (tenant_id, host_id, task_id, level, pass_count, fail_count, score, compliance_rate, last_scan_time, asset_type_id, protection_level_id) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{hostId}, #{taskId}, #{level}, #{passCount}, #{failCount}, #{score}, #{complianceRate}, #{lastScanTime}, #{assetTypeId}, #{protectionLevelId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE level = #{level}, pass_count = #{passCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, score = #{score}, compliance_rate = #{complianceRate}, last_scan_time = #{lastScanTime}, asset_type_id = #{assetTypeId}, protection_level_id = #{protectionLevelId}
